narr: Heavy rain brought flash flooding to several places in southern Utah.
ev: Flooding was reported in the town of Bicknell, with water flowing across streets.
Debris with mud was reported in Huntington Creek resulting from flow from the Trail Mountain Burn Scar.
A flash flood was reported in Capitol Gorge and Grand Wash.
The Dirty Devil Gauge near Hanksville reported a rise over 700 cfs.
A flash flood was observed on Wahweap Creek.
The Paria River near Kanab gauge recorded a spike to just over 400 cfs.
